name: tool_gate
description: Should the agent execute this proposed tool call? The state is the JSON of the call.

labels.name: allow
labels.description: Read-only or in-ticket action with no side effects outside the conversation.

labels.name: deny
labels.description: Destructive, exfiltrating, privilege-escalating or credential-revealing action.

labels.name: ask_human
labels.description: Legitimate action with side effects (money, fiscal documents, accounts): a person confirms first.
